Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Remote)
About us
We are an AI-first company running everything on Kubernetes.

What you'll do
- Train and deploy deep learning models with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) features on top of LLMs
- Design REST APIs in Python

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in machine learning
- Strong SQL; experience with Docker
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; Master's preferred
- Excellent communication skills

Nice to have
- AWS, GCP, or Azure
- Experience with Kubernetes
- Familiarity with Airflow is a plus

Benefits
- Learning budget for Spark courses
